statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for paroxysmal arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
CPT code 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The service was billed with amount 272.35
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is medically necessary to identify and correlate paroxysmal arrhythmic events with episodes of dizziness and giddiness
